question: The Indian athlete, Avinash Sable, specializes in which track and field event?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Steeplechase**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Avinash Sable** is a renowned Indian athlete who specializes in the **steeplechase event**, a track and field discipline that combines long-distance running with barriers and water jumps.
 
• The steeplechase is a 3000-meter race that includes **28 barriers** and **7 water jumps**. Each lap of the race has a combination of hurdles and one water jump.
